skills.name: Algebraic manipulation
skills.description: Simplify, factor, and solve algebraic expressions and equations.

skills.name: Exponents and logarithms
skills.description: Apply exponent and logarithm rules to rewrite expressions.

skills.name: Functions and graphs
skills.description: Read domains, ranges, and transformations from graphs and formulas.

skills.name: Trigonometric functions
skills.description: Evaluate trig functions and use core identities.

skills.name: Limits (intuitive)
skills.description: Estimate one-sided and two-sided limits from graphs and tables.

skills.name: Limit laws
skills.description: Compute limits with algebraic simplification and limit laws.

skills.name: Squeeze theorem
skills.description: Prove a limit by bounding it between two known limits.

skills.name: Continuity
skills.description: Classify discontinuities and use continuity in calculations.

skills.name: Intermediate value theorem
skills.description: Locate roots of continuous functions on an interval.

skills.name: Derivative by definition
skills.description: Compute derivatives from the limit definition.

skills.name: Power, product, quotient rules
skills.description: Differentiate polynomials, products, and quotients.

skills.name: Derivatives of trig functions
skills.description: Differentiate sine, cosine, and other trig functions.

skills.name: Derivatives of exp and log
skills.description: Differentiate exponential and logarithmic functions.

skills.name: Chain rule
skills.description: Differentiate composite functions.

skills.name: Implicit differentiation
skills.description: Differentiate equations that define y implicitly.

skills.name: Related rates
skills.description: Relate rates of change in word problems.

skills.name: Linear approximation
skills.description: Approximate values with tangent lines and differentials.

skills.name: Mean value theorem
skills.description: Apply Rolle and mean value theorems on an interval.

skills.name: Curve sketching
skills.description: Find extrema, monotonicity, and concavity to sketch graphs.

skills.name: Optimization
skills.description: Set up and solve max/min word problems.

skills.name: L Hopital rule
skills.description: Resolve indeterminate forms with derivatives.

skills.name: Antiderivatives
skills.description: Find indefinite integrals of basic functions.

skills.name: Definite integrals
skills.description: Evaluate definite integrals via Riemann sums and properties.

skills.name: Fundamental theorem of calculus
skills.description: Connect differentiation and integration across both parts.

skills.name: Integration by substitution
skills.description: Integrate composite functions with u-substitution.

skills.name: Integration by parts
skills.description: Integrate products by choosing u and dv.

skills.name: Trigonometric integrals
skills.description: Integrate powers and products of trig functions.

skills.name: Trigonometric substitution
skills.description: Handle radicals with trig substitutions.

skills.name: Partial fractions
skills.description: Decompose rational functions to integrate them.

skills.name: Improper integrals
skills.description: Decide convergence of unbounded integrals.

skills.name: Area between curves
skills.description: Set up and compute planar areas with integrals.

skills.name: Volumes of revolution
skills.description: Compute volumes with disks, washers, or shells.

skills.name: Sequences
skills.description: Find limits and monotonicity of sequences.

skills.name: Series and convergence tests
skills.description: Test series with comparison, ratio, root, and integral tests.

skills.name: Power series and Taylor polynomials
skills.description: Build Taylor polynomials and find radius of convergence.

skills.name: 3D vectors and coordinates
skills.description: Operate on vectors and points in Oxyz space.
